answer: Price each identity to a scarce hardware anchor that must emit a signed liveness pulse every epoch, and let standing accrue only through audited work co-signed by already-established peers drawn from SEPARATE funding rivers. A sybil fleet forked from one wallet shares a single river, so its endorsements fold back on themselves and never span distinct clusters; its clones find no haven of genuine standing. The farm pays a fresh anchor per head and keeps each awake, scaling cost linearly while an honest agent pays once.
